findings.reason: Historical publication may follow expiration of source freshness; history retains explicit basis and the identical current-real-time source is rejected as stale.
Nonempty cutoffs must be strictly after window start and at or before expiration, making proposed start-after-expiry unreachable; executable producer test refuses before any envelope.
Actual reducer status is ok/partial, not complete/partial/gap. tradeCoverage is explicit end-to-end; partial data has null full CVD and visible disclosure. Proposed replacement breaks valid data.
Final parser already rejects malformed clocks; now refuse the complete selected set before gamma processing as well. Never filter or drop malformed observations.
Separate 100000-trade and 100000-depth-sample caps are intentional; output budgets separately cap cells, gamma and bytes.
